quest.title: Equivalent Exchange Once More
quest.description: You see a familiar face in Sumeru City...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Hello, Traveler. You couldn't have come at a better time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's your wood carving going?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Uh... Mr. Vsevolod found out that I've been carving wood in secret...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: But he didn't really get angry about it. He just told me to stay focused while I'm at work... He even asked me for a wood carving of a bunny.

choices.text: Does he have a child to cajole too?

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Mr. Vsevolod said that my wood carvings have a strong Snezhnayan style, and that he really likes them.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: I've heard that Mr. Vsevolod's orders have kept him from going home to his family in Snezhnaya for a very long time now.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: I think he might really be homesick, unlike me...

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: *sigh* Let's stop here. Traveler, I've ordered another batch of wood from Hamawi. Please help me take a look at how it's going.

choices.text: Just get the payment ready.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Don't worry, I've prepared real currency for you this time.

choices.text: Don't you want to return to Snezhnaya?

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: It's not that bad for me... I don't have any relatives in Snezhnaya, and I'm used to traveling. It's quite comfortable here in Sumeru too...

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: I only spoke about returning to Snezhnaya because it was too boring in Mondstadt... *cough*!

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Anyway, I'm leaving this to you. I'll have your payment ready.

choices.text: You Fatui are real children at heart, aren't you...

dialogues.speaker: Hamawi
dialogues.text: What awful luck...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Viktor's wood...

dialogues.speaker: Hamawi
dialogues.text: Are you talking about the wood that the Fatuus ordered?

dialogues.speaker: Hamawi
dialogues.text: *sigh* I knew dealing with the Fatui wouldn't end well.

dialogues.speaker: Hamawi
dialogues.text: We were attacked by monsters while transporting that wood. All of us made it back alive, but our cart didn't. We were forced to leave the wood by the roadside.

dialogues.speaker: Hamawi
dialogues.text: I dare not go over there, nor can I find someone to get rid of those monsters so soon...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We aren't Fatui...

dialogues.speaker: Hamawi
dialogues.text: Aren't you a Fatuus? Then why are you helping him?

dialogues.speaker: Hamawi
dialogues.text: Anyway, I can only leave my cart there for now and see if I can hire someone to deal with the situation.

dialogues.speaker: Hamawi
dialogues.text: If you are anxious to get the wood, I'll mark the approximate location of the cart on the map for you, then you can go take a look for yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Hamawi
dialogues.text: *sigh* Nothing good ever comes of things that the Fatui are involved in...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: So, Traveler, how did it go?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Viktor what happened...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Wonderful, thank you, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Here's your payment. Now, I'll go back to writing Lily's letter.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: *sigh* Writing a letter to her makes me more nervous than writing a report for Mr. Vsevolod...

talks.objective: Go to where the cart is

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: I didn't expect myself to be able to pick up wood carving again...

talks.objective: Defeat all the Fungi and retrieve the plank

dialogues.speaker: Hamawi
dialogues.text: *sigh* Nothing good ever comes of things that the Fatui are involved in...

dialogues.speaker: Hamawi
dialogues.text: *sigh* Nothing good ever comes of things that the Fatui are involved in...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Viktor's wood...

dialogues.speaker: Hamawi
dialogues.text: This wood... You've chased away all the monsters? You're stronger than you look...

dialogues.speaker: Hamawi
dialogues.text: Thank you. I'll head over with a few others later and bring the wood back.

dialogues.speaker: Hamawi
dialogues.text: *sigh* Nothing good ever comes of things that the Fatui are involved in...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: How did it go? Has my wood arrived?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Viktor what happened...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Monsters again? Why does it feel like every cart in the world is being attacked by monsters...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Never mind. The wood got here, and that's what counts.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Oh, right. Here's the payment I promised you. Make sure to tally it up.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Uh, by the way... Um, is Lily doing well?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: I didn't say goodbye to her before I left. I hope she isn't angry...

choices.text: She's doing really well.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Alright. *cough*... Don't look at me like that. I was just a little concerned!

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Anyway, make sure you tally your remuneration, Traveler. I prepared the exact amount.

choices.text: Go back and visit her yourself, then.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Mr. Vsevolod will give me a real hiding if I do that, so forget it.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: I don't quite dare to send a letter directly either.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Receiving a letter from a Fatuus sounds like a bad thing. Hahaha...

dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: Hello there. Is there anything I can help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've been commissioned by Viktor...

dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: Oh, this is about the spices he asked me to purchase, right? I've got them right here, and I'll send them over in a while.

dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: Lunch? Oh my, we were quite busy today, so almost all the ingredients have been used up...

dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: I know! Traveler, can you get me two potatoes?

dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: In return... I'll make you some Panipuri. Thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Jut
dialogues.text: Did you get the Windwheel Aster?

dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: Perfect. These should be enough. Please give me a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Lambad starts cooking...

dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: It's done. This serving is for you. Please take the other two servings of Panipuri to those two.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: So, what did Lambad say?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Viktor what happened...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Lambad really is a reliable boss and a really nice person.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Unlike the others who instinctively become wary of us when they find out that we're Fatui.

choices.text: That's your own fault, alright?

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Oh, it smells really good. I bet Vsevolod would like it too.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Seriously...

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: And here's the payment I promised you. Tally it up if you have to.

choices.text: It's the Fatui's fault that things are like that...

dialogues.speaker: Jut
dialogues.text: What does a Windwheel Aster smell like?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Viktor's commission...

dialogues.speaker: Jut
dialogues.text: Yes, I did make an agreement with him. He'll help me find rare plants, and I'll help him make a sachet.

dialogues.speaker: Jut
dialogues.text: You're the one he hired to help, right? If you get a Windwheel Aster, you can just pass it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Jut
dialogues.text: This is a Windwheel Aster? Hmm, an interesting plant indeed...

dialogues.speaker: Jut
dialogues.text: I'll take it. Tell him to leave making a sachet to me.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: How did it go? Has the wood I ordered arrived?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Viktor what happened...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Monsters again? Why does it feel like every cart in the world is being attacked by monsters...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Never mind, as long my wood gets here, I'm fine with it.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Oh, right. Here's the payment I promised you. Tally it up if you like.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: So... about Lily...

dialogues.speaker: Vsevolod
dialogues.text: Viktor, is this the Traveler you told me about?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Ahem! Yes! Commander, this is the Traveler!

dialogues.speaker: Vsevolod
dialogues.text: What were you talking about? Did I interrupt you?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: No sir! I was talking with the Traveler about the commission!

dialogues.speaker: Vsevolod
dialogues.text: Thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Vsevolod
dialogues.text: Hello, Traveler. It's an honor to be with you today.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Vsevolod
dialogues.text: Hello Traveler. Actually, I've already learned about you through various means.

dialogues.speaker: Vsevolod
dialogues.text: Looks like you and us the Fatui are meant to meet.

dialogues.speaker: Vsevolod
dialogues.text: Viktor told me that you refused to join the Fatui in Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Vsevolod
dialogues.text: I don't know if that's still your choice?

choices.text: Yes.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Sir, this traveler actually is...

response.speaker: Vsevolod
response.text: That's enough Viktor. I won't have any feelings about the Traveler's choice.

response.speaker: Vsevolod
response.text: On the contrary... I respect those who stick to their choice and see it through.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I stand by my decision.

response.speaker: Vsevolod
response.text: I have no doubt about that.

response.speaker: Vsevolod
response.text: If you would excuse me, I have other errands to run.

response.speaker: Vsevolod
response.text: Hehe... I deeply believe that sooner or later we will have a chance to work together, Traveler.

choices.text: I refuse to join the Fatui.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: So, what did Lambad say?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Viktor what happened...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Lambad really is a reliable boss and a really nice person.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: He's not like the others, who instinctively become wary of us when they find out that we're Fatui.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: What a "great" job to be a Fatuus nowadays, heh...

dialogues.speaker: Vsevolod
dialogues.text: Viktor, is this the Traveler you told me about?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: ... It was tough indeed!

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: That's right, this is the Traveler. Wh—What brings you here, sir.

dialogues.speaker: Vsevolod
dialogues.text: I was dealing with some stuff, and happened to pass by. I saw you discussing something with the Traveler...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: I was talking with the Traveler about the commission, sir!

dialogues.speaker: Vsevolod
dialogues.text: Mmm... Getting assigned from Mondstadt all the way to here is by no means easy. It's gonna take a while to settle in.

dialogues.speaker: Vsevolod
dialogues.text: Let me know if you have any trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Yes! Thank you, sir!

dialogues.speaker: Vsevolod
dialogues.text: And this... Traveler. Your reputation precedes you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Vsevolod
dialogues.text: Hello Traveler. Actually, I've already learned about you through various means.

dialogues.speaker: Vsevolod
dialogues.text: Looks like you and us the Fatui are meant to meet.

dialogues.speaker: Vsevolod
dialogues.text: Viktor told me that you refused to join the Fatui in Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Vsevolod
dialogues.text: I don't know if that's still your choice?

choices.text: Yes.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Sir, this traveler actually is...

response.speaker: Vsevolod
response.text: That's enough Viktor. I won't have any feelings about the Traveler's choice.

response.speaker: Vsevolod
response.text: On the contrary... I respect those who stick to their choice and see it through.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I stand by my decision.

response.speaker: Vsevolod
response.text: I have no doubt about that.

response.speaker: Vsevolod
response.text: If you would excuse me, I have other errands to run.

response.speaker: Vsevolod
response.text: Hehe... I deeply believe that sooner or later we will have a chance to work together, Traveler.

choices.text: I refuse to join the Fatui.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: So, Traveler, how did it go?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Viktor what happened...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Wonderful, thank you, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Here's your payment. Now, where was I...

dialogues.speaker: Vsevolod
dialogues.text: Viktor, is this the Traveler you told me about?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: ... Got some business to tend to!

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: S—Sir! What are you...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Ahem... Y—Yes! Commander, this is the Traveler I mentioned.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Vsevolod
dialogues.text: Mmm, hello Traveler. Actually, I've already learned about you through various means.

dialogues.speaker: Vsevolod
dialogues.text: Looks like you and us the Fatui are meant to meet.

dialogues.speaker: Vsevolod
dialogues.text: Viktor told me that you refused to join the Fatui in Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Vsevolod
dialogues.text: I don't know if that's still your choice?

choices.text: Yes.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Sir, this traveler actually is...

response.speaker: Vsevolod
response.text: That's enough Viktor. I won't have any feelings about the Traveler's choice.

response.speaker: Vsevolod
response.text: More than that... I respect those who stick to their choice and see it through.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I stand by my decision.

response.speaker: Vsevolod
response.text: I have no doubt about that.

response.speaker: Vsevolod
response.text: If you would excuse me, I have other errands to run.

response.speaker: Vsevolod
response.text: Hehe... I deeply believe that sooner or later we will have a chance to work together, traveler.

choices.text: I refuse to join the Fatui.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Traveler, perfect timing! Come over here and help me with something.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you up to now?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: I'm trying to make a dish from Sumeru using Snezhnayan cooking methods.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: But I don't recognize many spices from Sumeru, so I'm having to do it slowly by trial and error...

choices.text: Is this a Fatuus' job too?

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Uh... Inspecting the quality of spices is within the scope of my job, of course.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: But let's get back to business. Because my... work schedule for inspecting the quality of spices has been too tight, the spices are consumed rapidly.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: After some discussions with Mr. Vsevolod, we've decided to commission Mr. Lambad to purchase spices for us.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: We're regulars at Mr. Lambad's tavern, so we trust his judgment.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Traveler, please help me ask Mr. Lambad about how the purchase of spices is going.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Besides that... Ask him if he has any good food ready. It's almost mealtime...

choices.text: Alright.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Unfortunately, Mr. Vsevolod is always away for work, or I would have introduced you to him.

choices.text: I don't want to get to know a Fatuus.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: We'd just be saying hello. We aren't high-ranking Fatui, we just manage logistics. What kind of trouble could we possibly bring you?

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Anyway, I'll be leaving this to you, Traveler.

choices.text: I don't want to join the Fatui.
You just wanted food, right?

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: It's part of my job! Am I the kind of person who neglects his job and only thinks about food? Trust me, alright?

choices.text: You sure seem happy about all this...

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Huh? Uh... Sort of? I wouldn't consider it out of the ordinary. I go to work every day, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Mr. Vsevolod is working all day. In fact, I've even heard that he hasn't been back to Snezhnaya in years. I really wonder how he made it up till now...

dialogues.speaker: Lambad
dialogues.text: Did you get the potatoes?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Why are these spices so expensive?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you not bought the spices yet?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Traveler! You're finally here. Uh... I have a question for you...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: D—Do you have any Windwheel Aster?

choices.text: Why are you suddenly asking that?

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Remember how I was busy with the spices? I heard Lambad mention something called a "sachet" during our discussion.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: To be specific, various flowers are dried in a small cloth pouch, some even sprinkle a dash of perfume on it...

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: So, they tell me that ladies are really fond of these "sachets"...

choices.text: I never expected this from you, Viktor...

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: N—No! What are you talking about? Don't you remember that we spoke about sending Lily a letter?

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: After giving it a lot of thought, I've decided to write Lily a letter. Leaving without saying goodbye was a terrible decision...

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Of course, making a sachet is absolutely beyond me, nor do I have enough materials. That's why I asked Jut to gather the materials for me.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: But I couldn't afford the spices in his shop... So, I offered him "equivalent exchange."

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Simply put, I'll give him rare plants in exchange for him helping me to gather rare spices.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: I promised Jut that I'd get him a Windwheel Aster, but I can't return to Mondstadt right now...

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: So, Traveler, could you help me with this?

choices.text: Just get my payment ready.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: No problem. There'll be enough to go around, believe me!

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: I'm counting on you. I'll be waiting for you here.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: But how should I start my letter to Lily?

choices.text: Is this another one of the Fatui's plans?

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Of course not. Mr. Vsevolod would have asked for funding if it were. Why would I even have to ask for your help then?

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Anyway, I'm trying to get away from the Fatui now, so I don't care about any of their plans.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: I've had enough of being suspected all the time...

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Oh, don't tell anyone about this, or they'll call me in for a little... chat...

choices.text: You're really planning on settling down in Sumeru, huh?
What do you need Windwheel Aster for?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: How should I start my letter to Lily?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: "Dear Lily"... Wait, I can't write that.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: "Hi, Lily"... Well, that doesn't sound too bad...
